title: Ready-made store templates vs. **AI**-guided building: which is faster to get started with?
summary: See which to choose to get started faster in Jestor: ready-made store templates or AI-guided building.
body_markdown:
In **[Jestor](https://jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com)** , you can start a process by installing one of the store's ready-made templates — over 30 configured solutions — or by describing the process in text for the **AI** -guided build agent to put together from scratch.


## Which path is actually faster


Anyone getting started with Jestor often wonders which path is faster: grabbing something ready-made or asking the **AI** to build exactly what the company needs, without having to tweak a generic model afterward.


The answer depends on how closely the company's process resembles a common market case — and getting this initial choice wrong costs unnecessary setup time.


## How to decide which path to follow


1. Use a ready-made template for common processes, like CRM, task management, or fleet management.
2. Use **AI** building when the process is specific to your business, with no market standard.
3. Combine both: install the template and ask the **AI** to adjust whatever's different.
4. Give as much context as possible when asking the **AI** to build.
5. Use the agent's conversation history to keep tweaking the app afterward.


Path Initial time Level of customization


Ready-made template Practically instant Already configured, editable afterward


**AI** building Minutes, depending on how detailed the request is Born customized to the described process


## Why choose Jestor?


**[Jestor](https://jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com)** even lets you move from one path to the other: an installed template can later be edited by the same **AI** build agent, so your initial choice isn't final.


### Frequently Asked Questions


**Can the AI agent edit a template that's already installed?** Yes, the same **AI** -guided build agent can edit both apps built from scratch and already-installed templates.


**Can ready-made templates be combined with each other?** Yes, you can install more than one template and connect them, as your operation needs.


**Do I need to know how to code to use AI-guided building?** No, the request is made in natural language, with no technical knowledge required.
